items.headline: Former Vandy QB, Heisman Trophy runner-up Pavia goes No. 1 in UFL draft
items.description: Diego Pavia, who starred at Vanderbilt, was the top pick in Wednesday's United Football League draft. The quarterback went to the Columbus Aviators.

items.headline: Georgia AG asks SEC to take action against LSU's 'contempt for the rules'
items.description: The Georgia Attorney General blasted LSU in a letter to SEC commissioner Greg Sankey, encouraging sanctions against the Tigers, "up to and including expulsion."

items.headline: QB rankings for all 68 Power 4 college football teams
items.description: We're nearing the end of the season. How have our opinions about the top quarterbacks changed?

items.headline: Who's on College Football Playoff bubble after the committee's third ranking?
items.description: A conference-by-conference look at which teams are contending for the playoff, who's close and who's out.

items.headline: Clark Lea calls for Vandy's biggest improvement to be on offense
items.description: Lea explains the ups and downs the Commodores had against Alabama and how they need to get better offensively if they want to have a shot at making a bowl game.

items.headline: SEC matchup features No. 23 Florida taking on Vanderbilt
items.description: Vanderbilt (4-6) at No. 23 Florida (6-4), Nov. 21 at 12 p.m. EST.
